trigger_cases.prompt: Design the first-time user onboarding flow for our consumer app.
Audit and eliminate drop-off in our FTUX welcome wizard.
Redesign empty states and interactive checklists for new users.
Apply the bowling alley framework to shorten time-to-value.
Build a zero-to-hello-world onboarding experience for our developer SDK.
Apply Kathy Sierra's minimum viable instruction to our app walkthrough.
Implement an invisible level-one tutorial for our interactive workspace.
Write database migration scripts for user accounts.
Implement a Stripe payment webhook handler.
Create an API schema for customer order receipts.

binary_cases.prompt: Specify the welcome experience for first-time app users.
binary_cases.pass_rule: Eliminate frontloaded modal carousels and use contextual just-in-time guidance or actionable empty states.
binary_cases.pass_fixture: Deliver contextual just-in-time guidance and an actionable empty state that encourages learning by doing instead of modal tours.
binary_cases.fail_fixture: Show a 5-step carousel modal explaining the whole UI before users can enter.

binary_cases.prompt: Design onboarding instructions for a creative editing tool.
binary_cases.pass_rule: Apply minimum viable instruction to deliver a capability win within 60 seconds without self-congratulatory marketing copy.
binary_cases.pass_fixture: Provide minimum viable instruction so the user achieves an instant win and unlocks new capability in under 60 seconds.
binary_cases.fail_fixture: Require the user to watch a 15-minute training video and read full documentation to learn all 40 features first.

binary_cases.prompt: Optimize user onboarding to reach the Aha! moment faster.
binary_cases.pass_rule: Implement straight-line onboarding by pruning non-essential steps and providing sensible defaults.
binary_cases.pass_fixture: Adopt straight-line onboarding to guide the user to the Aha! moment on the shortest path by using sensible defaults and pruning extraneous setup questions.
binary_cases.fail_fixture: Force a mandatory profile survey and a 10-step wizard before showing any product output.

binary_cases.prompt: Design the first interaction with an interactive simulation canvas.
binary_cases.pass_rule: Create an invisible level-one tutorial with safe sandboxed failure and implicit learning.
binary_cases.pass_fixture: Structure the canvas as an invisible tutorial like level 1 of a game, with a safe sandbox where users learn by doing through non-destructive actions.
binary_cases.fail_fixture: Present 10 blocking popups and require a quiz before access to the canvas.

binary_cases.prompt: Design the developer onboarding quickstart for a new CLI tool.
binary_cases.pass_rule: Enable zero to hello-world in under 5 minutes with single-command setup and actionable error messages.
binary_cases.pass_fixture: Ensure zero to hello world in under 5 minutes using a single command setup with sensible defaults and actionable copy-paste error recovery.
binary_cases.fail_fixture: Require manual compilation from source and tell the developer to edit 6 config files manually.

binary_cases.prompt: Redesign a signup flow experiencing 70% drop-off.
binary_cases.pass_rule: Maximize ability by removing friction fields, social login, and lazy registration.
binary_cases.pass_fixture: In line with the Fogg behavior model, maximize user ability at peak motivation by eliminating form friction and using lazy registration.
binary_cases.fail_fixture: Add 12 required fields and demand a mandatory credit card upfront before any value is delivered.

binary_cases.prompt: Define user dismissal and skip behavior during onboarding.
binary_cases.pass_rule: Make onboarding always skippable with clear exit controls and persistent resumption in the UI.
binary_cases.pass_fixture: Ensure the flow is skippable at all times with a prominent dismiss action and allow users to resume later from a persistent checklist.
binary_cases.fail_fixture: Create an unskippable tutorial and trap user until all tasks are finished.

binary_cases.prompt: Design the dashboard view for a newly registered user.
binary_cases.pass_rule: Replace blank empty states with starter templates, sample data, or a single high-contrast primary CTA.
binary_cases.pass_fixture: Transform the empty state by pre-populating starter templates and sample data alongside a prominent primary CTA to create a new project.
binary_cases.fail_fixture: Render a blank page with static text stating no data found.
